bossbar.title: %1$s · %2$s
event.blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
event.blood_moon.start.title: Blood Moon
event.blood_moon.start.subtitle: The monsters grow stronger...
event.blood_moon.start.chat: A Blood Moon rises. Monsters are more numerous and stronger tonight, but drop better loot.
event.blood_moon.end: The Blood Moon fades. You survived the night.
event.blood_moon.no_sleep: You cannot sleep during the Blood Moon
event.gold_rush.name: Gold Rush
event.gold_rush.start.title: Gold Rush
event.gold_rush.start.subtitle: Ores drop double!
event.gold_rush.start.chat: Gold Rush! For a few minutes, ores drop more. Grab your pickaxe.
event.meteor_shower.name: Meteor Shower
event.meteor_shower.start.title: Meteor Shower
event.meteor_shower.start.subtitle: Look up at the sky...
event.meteor_shower.start.chat: A meteor shower lights up the sky! Some meteors will fall nearby: look for their craters, they are full of ores.
mob.mimic_sack.appeared: A mimic sack is hopping nearby! Hit it before it gets away.
mob.mimic_sack.caught: The mimic sack burst into gold!
mob.living_meteorite.rises: Something is climbing out of the crater!
event.thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
event.thunderstorm.start.title: Thunderstorm
event.thunderstorm.start.subtitle: Lightning is coming down...
event.thunderstorm.start.chat: A raging thunderstorm! Lightning strikes all around, creepers get charged and storm spirits roam the sky. Defeat them to bottle their lightning.
event.thunderstorm.end: The storm passes and the sky clears.
item.bottled_lightning.fail: Aim at a block nearby to call the lightning.
command.start.busy: %s is already active here. Use /worldevents stop first.
command.start.unavailable: %s can't happen in this dimension right now (check the dimension, difficulty and game rules).
command.stop.none: No event is active in this dimension.
command.status.planned: %1$s: no event, next will be %2$s (waiting for the right moment)
command.reload.failure: Could not reload the config; keeping the previous one. Check the server log.
mob.blood_moon_lord.arrived: The Blood Moon Lord has arrived! Follow its glow.
mob.blood_moon_lord.defeated: %s has defeated the Blood Moon Lord!
mob.blood_moon_lord.retreat: The Blood Moon Lord fades away with the dawn.
item.bloody_tear.fail: The moon does not answer... (only at night, with no other event going on)
event.blessed_harvest.name: Blessed Harvest
event.blessed_harvest.start.title: Blessed Harvest
event.blessed_harvest.start.subtitle: The fields are blooming...
event.blessed_harvest.start.chat: A blessed harvest! Crops near you grow by themselves and ripe crops drop double. A harvest spirit will keep you company and leave you golden seeds.
mob.harvest_spirit.appeared: A harvest spirit has come to help with your crops.
mob.harvest_spirit.seed: The harvest spirit left you a golden seed!
item.golden_seed.fail: There are no crops here to grow.
event.merchant_caravan.name: Merchant Caravan
event.merchant_caravan.start.title: Merchant Caravan
event.merchant_caravan.start.subtitle: Rare goods are passing through...
event.merchant_caravan.start.chat: A merchant caravan is passing through! Find the nomad merchant and trade emeralds for rare goods before the caravan moves on.
event.merchant_caravan.end: The caravan packs up and moves on.
mob.nomad_merchant.arrived: A merchant caravan has set up camp near %s.
event.horde.name: Horde
event.horde.start.title: The Horde
event.horde.start.subtitle: Three waves are coming...
event.horde.start.chat: A horde is coming! Survive three waves of monsters; the Horde Warlord leads the last one.
event.horde.wave.title: Wave %s
event.horde.wave.subtitle: Here they come!
event.horde.wave.final: The Horde Warlord leads the attack!
event.horde.wave.cleared: Wave cleared! The next one is coming...
command.summon.failed: Could not summon %s there (is the area loaded?).
event.warning: Something is coming: %1$s, in about %2$s seconds.
event.ranking.seals: You earned %s event seal(s). Nomad merchants take them for relics.
event.treasure_hunt.name: Treasure Hunt
event.treasure_hunt.start.title: Treasure Hunt
event.treasure_hunt.start.subtitle: A treasure is hidden nearby...
event.treasure_hunt.start.chat: Treasure hunt! A chest full of loot lies hidden on the surface nearby. Watch the action bar to know how warm you are; the first to open it wins. Beware of whatever guards it.
event.treasure_hunt.hidden: The treasure has appeared. Follow the column of light!
event.treasure_hunt.guarded: The spectral captain keeps the chest shut.
event.treasure_hunt.free: The captain has fallen: the treasure is free!
mob.spectral_captain.arrived: The spectral captain rises to guard the treasure!
event.eruption.name: Eruption
event.eruption.start.title: Eruption
event.eruption.start.subtitle: The ground is burning...
event.eruption.start.chat: The Nether erupts! Geysers of fire burst from the ground: watch for smoke and step aside. Something huge is waking below.
mob.magma_colossus.retreat: The magma colossus sinks back into the lava.
event.void_storm.name: Void Storm
event.void_storm.start.title: Void Storm
event.void_storm.start.subtitle: The void is watching...
event.void_storm.start.chat: A void storm! Stalkers blink out of nowhere to hunt you, and pulses of the void lift you off the ground. Defeat them for their unstable pearls.
